issues.title: Expired session is refreshed anyway
issues.explanation: After deleting an expired session the code falls through, extends it and saves it again. That violates AUTH-88 and keeps expired sessions alive.
issues.fix: Return null inside the expiry branch after deleting.

issues.title: Null check removed
issues.explanation: The diff drops the !session check. An unknown token now throws a TypeError on session.expiresAt, hidden only by the catch.
issues.fix: Keep `if (!session) return null;` after the get.

issues.title: catch swallows every error
issues.explanation: A Redis outage now looks like 'not signed in' and silently logs every user out, with nothing logged.
issues.fix: Catch only expected errors; log and rethrow store failures.
